title: State Pages for the Owner Auto Policy: Notice Days and Underwriting Periods
content:
**Owner Auto Policy — company schedule by garaging state.** The day counts below are the company's schedule and apply on every Cardinal Point liability package. All counts are calendar days.

| Garaging state | New-business underwriting period (days after the original effective date) | Advance notice of an underwriting cancellation | Notice of cancellation for nonpayment (days from mailing to the cancellation effective date) | Nonrenewal notice (days before expiration) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Florida | 60 | 45 | 10 | 45 |
| Virginia | 60 | 45 | 15 | 45 |
| Texas | 60 | 10 | 10 | 30 |
| Georgia | 60 | 45 | 10 | 45 |
| Arizona | 60 | 45 | 10 | 45 |
| Ohio | 90 | 30 | 10 | 30 |

**Column meanings.**
- **New-business underwriting period:** the calendar days after the original effective date during which the company may cancel a new-business policy for any underwriting reason.
- **Advance notice of an underwriting cancellation:** the days of advance written notice the company gives before an underwriting cancellation takes effect. An underwriting cancellation is one unrelated to nonpayment.
- **Notice of cancellation for nonpayment:** the minimum calendar days between the mailing date of the notice and the cancellation effective date. This is the company's schedule and is never shorter than the state's minimum.
- **Nonrenewal notice:** the minimum calendar days before expiration by which a company nonrenewal notice must be mailed.

**Underwriting reasons that survive the underwriting period (all packages and states).** After the new-business underwriting period, an in-force policy may still be cancelled for underwriting only for these reasons:
- the named insured's license is suspended or revoked; or
- there was material misrepresentation on the application.

**Reading across a row (hypothetical).** For a Virginia-garaged term, a notice of cancellation for nonpayment mailed on the 1st of a month leaves at least 15 days before the cancellation effective date, so that date is no earlier than the 16th. For a Texas-garaged term's notice mailed the same day, it is no earlier than the 11th.
